summary: Legacy runtime-start repair can positively exclude protected user-manager, logind-session, and pre-operation processes without reading their environment

schema.detail: No database or replicated claim schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Native repair evidence reports excluded processes with PID, comm, cgroup, and reason. These diagnostics alone do not change item IDs or filtered/unfiltered approval tokens; all physical closure predicates remain fenced.

downtime.detail: Only the normal daemon rollout is required.

manual.detail: Continue reviewing a fresh subject/class-filtered repair dry-run and applying its exact token. Unreadable processes without positive cgroup or conservative creation-time exclusion still refuse repair.

recovery.detail: No process is signaled or attached, and no PTY row or native session is changed.
